description: This file defines the Maintenance class within the Opencart catalog startup controller namespace. The class contains an index method that checks if the site is under maintenance and appropriately redirects users based on their login status and route.

classes.name: Maintenance
classes.description: Handles site maintenance mode, redirecting users when maintenance is enabled and depending on their authentication status.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Checks if maintenance mode is active and redirects users to the maintenance page unless they are logged in or accessing ignored routes.
